setting: Deep dusk. A hunter that finds warm bodies is seen only when it is nearly on them
seen: It is afraid at the first glimpse and gone; a fear that takes longer to rise is still rising when the jaws close

setting: Broad day. A hunter is seen from far off
seen: Its fear has risen long before the hunter arrives; a fear that rises slowly has not
ownSetting: a harmless neighbour that calls now and then: a fear that rises at the ordinary rate ignores one call, and one that rises quickly stops its feeding every time

setting: A harmless neighbour that calls now and then
seen: One call does not frighten it and it goes on feeding; a fear that rises quickly stops it every time
ownSetting: a real hunter seen from far off: a fear that rises slowly is too late, one that rises at the ordinary rate is not

setting: A harmless neighbour that calls now and then, and a fear that rises quickly
seen: It starts at each call and is feeding again at once

setting: A harmless neighbour that calls now and then, and a fear that rises quickly
seen: It stops for a few moments at each call and then feeds again; a fear that lingers a long time never lets it feed

setting: A hunter of middling speed in open country, which drops behind where the prey cannot see it
seen: Its fear outlasts the sight of the hunter and it keeps running; a fear that is gone at once lets it stop while the hunter is still behind it
ownSetting: a big harmless animal passes once: a fear that lingers a long time does fade, and it feeds again; one that lasts until calmed, with nothing to calm it, never lets it feed again

setting: It hatches in a burrow, wanders far off, and long afterwards a hard frost comes. The burrow is the only shelter
seen: It still knows the way home, and goes; a memory that only lingers a long time has faded, and it dies in the open
unit: beats lived through a frost, of 1500

setting: Deep dusk. A hunter that finds warm bodies is seen only when it is nearly on them, and fear rises at the ordinary rate
seen: A little fear is enough to make it run, and it runs in time

setting: A harmless neighbour that calls now and then, and a fear that rises quickly
seen: It stops at each call, but not for long; a fear that kicks in low keeps it frozen most of the time, and one that kicks in high barely stops it at all

setting: A harmless neighbour that calls now and then, and a fear that rises quickly
seen: It takes a great deal to frighten it, and it barely pauses in its feeding

setting: A young one, its parent that walks steadily on, and three other adults milling about
seen: It follows the one it first knew, through the others; without the bond it follows whichever is nearest and is soon with a stranger
unit: beats within 30 of its own parent, of 500
ownUnit: beats within 30 of its own parent, of 500

setting: It hatches in a burrow, wanders far off, and then a hard frost comes. The burrow is the only shelter
seen: It knows where it was born and goes back there
unit: beats lived through a frost, of 1500
ownUnit: beats lived through a frost, of 1500

setting: Six that lay, and one animal that eats every egg it finds
seen: They all lay in the same few beats, and there are more eggs than the egg-eater can get round before they hatch. Laying each in its own time, they feed it one clutch after another

setting: A harmless neighbour that calls now and then. Its fear rises quickly
seen: It takes three calls close together to frighten it, and one call at a time never does; without the count every call stops its feeding

setting: Six that lay, and a small animal that eats every egg it finds
seen: A third of them are born guards: they go for the egg-eater and kill it, and the eggs hatch

setting: Three with their backs to a hunter. One of their kind, in front of them, sees it
seen: They see fear on the one that faces them, take fright themselves and run, without ever seeing the hunter

setting: Food all about, and big animals of another kind that bite whatever touches them
seen: Bitten once, it knows that kind and keeps clear of it; without the lesson it walks into them again and again

setting: A hunter, in country full of food that it wants badly
seen: Once afraid it has no thought for food and runs; without that, appetite outweighs fear and it stops to eat

setting: It is drawn alike to rocks and to scrub. There is food by the rocks. In the scrub there is only a small animal that bites
seen: Each bite it takes in the scrub makes the scrub draw it less, until it wanders off and finds the rocks. Without the habit it goes back to the scrub for as long as it lives

setting: A colony of helpers whose one breeder has died. Only a breeder lays
seen: With no breeder in sight, one of them slowly changes, grows into a breeder and begins to lay. Without that the colony dies out
